user.title: CC1101 Rolling Shutter
user.description: Configure the serial link to the CC1101 module.

reconfigure.title: Change the serial link
reconfigure.description: Change the serial port or baud rate. Your shutters and their room assignment are preserved.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The serial link has been updated.

add_shutter.title: Add a shutter
add_shutter.description: Shutters heard on the air appear in the list ({discovered} available). Press a button on the original remote to make one show up. You can also type a 4-byte ID directly.

error.already_exists: A shutter with this ID already exists.
error.invalid_id: A shutter ID is 4 bytes, written as 8 hex digits (e.g. 12345600 or 12:34:56:00).
error.id_required: Pick a discovered shutter or type an ID.

abort.no_shutters: There is no shutter to remove yet.
